**eraseOnClick doesn't work as expected**

The shape on the board can be erased by either clicking - which deleted all shapes - or by redrawing the same shape - which deletes just that shape.

https://github.com/lichess-org/chessground/blob/aad96fd5f5c6f95168d894986f106ab1846c2205/src/drag.ts#L35

Also, drawClear is not something that is exposed by chessground, so I can't even override it.

I would like to be able to disable the "erase on click" functionality somehow.

Thanks.

# Fix: `eraseOnClick` doesn't work as expected (upstream issue #322)

## Problem
Clicking on an empty square or a piece of the other color always erases all drawn
shapes (`drawClear` in `src/drag.ts` `start()`), regardless of any config. The only
knob, `drawable.eraseOnMovablePieceClick`, only guards clicks on a (unselected)
piece of the turn color. There is no way to disable erase-on-click entirely.

## Root cause
`drag.start()` gates `drawClear(s)` on
`(s.drawable.eraseOnMovablePieceClick || !piece || piece.color !== s.turnColor)`.
The `!piece` and `piece.color !== s.turnColor` branches bypass every option.
Historically `drawable.eraseOnClick` was a master switch, but it was renamed to
`eraseOnMovablePieceClick` with narrower semantics; the master switch was lost
(upstream PR #176 with the intended semantics was never merged).

        `eraseOnMovablePieceClick` is true (current behavior preserved).
